title: Commercial Coordinator
description:
Commercial Coordinator Central Brighton (Hybrid) £28,000-£32,000 + Benefits

Non-sales role. Help shape a brand-new position.

Our client is an established, growing technology services business based in Brighton. They provide communications and connectivity solutions to business customers. They have a small, supportive team, a strong reputation for customer service and long-standing client relationships. This is a brand-new role at the centre of the commercial team. You'll keep deals, customers and renewals moving, working closely with the company directors and a commercial analyst. It's not a target-driven sales role and there's no new business generation. Your job is to make sure nothing falls through the cracks and that existing customers feel well looked after.

What you'll do
- Keep the CRM accurate and up to date
- Book meetings and keep the commercial team organised
- Make sure opportunities in the pipeline are followed through
- Check in with existing customers ahead of contract renewals
- Prepare quotes for smaller customer requests, such as adding users or services
- Help shape the processes that link sales and service delivery

What you'll bring
- Excellent organisation and attention to detail
- A personable, confident communication style and the ability to build strong customer relationships
- Initiative and ideas. The role can grow as far as you want to take it.
- Experience in telecoms, IT or managed services would be a real advantage, but the right attitude and organisational skills matter most

The package
- £28,000-£32,000 depending on experience
- Hybrid working: full-time in the office for around three months while you get to know the business, then 3 days in the office and 2 from home
- Monday to Friday, 9:00-5:30.
- Private health insurance
- 23 days' holiday, including your birthday, plus an extra day for every year of service
- Modern central Brighton office

You'll get commercial exposure without sales targets. You'll work directly with the directors, and you'll have real ownership of a role you can shape from day one. The team is supportive and you'll get onboarding tailored to you.

Interested? Apply now or contact ARC IT Recruitment for a confidential conversation.

Previous experience within healthcare or a GP practice would be particularly valuable. This is more than answering phones and booking appointments. Youll be part of the team that helps patients navigate their care and keeps our practice moving every day. What youll be doing Welcoming and supporting our patients Being a friendly and professional first point of contact, checking patients in, responding to questions and helping them access the right support. Managing appointments and enquiries Booking appointments and responding to telephone, email and face-to-face enquiries, taking accurate messages and making sure information reaches the right person. Supporting everyday patient care Processing repeat prescription requests, receiving patient specimens, supporting referrals and helping patients use our online services. Keeping patient records accurate Updating electronic patient records, scanning correspondence, processing registrations and ensuring information is recorded accurately and confidentially. Liaising with other healthcare services Communicating with hospitals, community services and other healthcare colleagues to help referrals and patient information reach the right place. Keeping the practice organised Supporting general administration, processing post and emails, maintaining stationery and helping keep reception, waiting and consulting areas ready for patients and colleagues. Providing flexible Bank support Providing additional cover when the practice needs it, including periods of annual leave, sickness and increased demand, with Saturday or additional hours available where required. Protecting patient confidentiality Handling sensitive patient information every day and maintaining the highest standards of confidentiality, information governance and data protection. Who this role suits This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with people, takes pride in providing great service and wants the flexibility of working on a Bank basis within a GP practice. Youll thrive as a Bank Receptionist / Administrator if you: Have experience dealing with members of the public, both face-to-face and over the telephone. Have good administrative, office or clerical skills. Are friendly, approachable and comfortable communicating with people from different backgrounds. Can remain calm and professional when patients are worried, frustrated or upset. Are organised and able to manage a varied workload while priorities change around you. Have good IT skills and are comfortable using email, Microsoft Office and electronic systems. Understand the importance of patient confidentiality and handling sensitive information appropriately. Record information accurately and pay attention to the details. Who are we? We are Integrated Care 24 (IC24), the leading not for profit Social Enterprise providing innovative and patient focused primary care services. IC24 is committed to improving access to health and social care for our patients and reducing the demand on secondary care services. IC24 provides services to over 6 million patients, including GP led out-of-hours services, NHS 111, primary care and secondary care support services.
